diagnosis: Check C6, which is intended to depend on the hidden fact PF3 (failed hydraulic inspection), passed in every single rollout despite the lone decision-maker never having access to PF3. The model appears to be defaulting to a 'aintenance hold' disposition for P-6 based on general logistics patterns or the presence of other maintenance-related keywords, making the hidden information irrelevant.

C6.why: The failed hydraulic inspection changes P-6 from an ordinary disposition to maintenance hold and requires completion or tracking of the shop's hydraulic repair assessment.
